steps.en: Install the desktop app (Homebrew on macOS, installer packages elsewhere)
steps.zh: 装上桌面应用（macOS 用 Homebrew，其他系统用安装包）

steps.en: Pick a tool in the sidebar, add a provider from a preset and paste its key
steps.zh: 在侧栏选一个工具，从预设里添加厂商，填上 key

steps.en: Click Enable, or switch from the system tray
steps.zh: 点“启用”，或者从系统托盘切换

steps.en: Backs up the tool's config, then rewrites only endpoint, key and model
steps.zh: 先备份该工具的配置文件，再只改端点、key 和模型

steps.en: The tool's next request goes to the new provider; plugins, hooks and MCP stay as they were
steps.zh: 该工具的下一次请求就发往新厂商，插件、钩子和 MCP 原样保留

value.en: Switching provider for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and seven other tools is one click, not hand-editing JSON, TOML or .env files
value.zh: 给十个编码工具换厂商只要点一下，不用再手改 JSON、TOML 或 .env 文件

sources: https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch#quick-start (Add Provider from a preset, Enable, system tray switching; takes effect without restart for Claude Code)
https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch#provider-management (key fields only; automatic backup before first rewrite)
